digest.component_or_area: plan review verdict generation and workflow failure handling
propositions: Stale or malformed repository criteria configuration causes CriteriaError during deterministic assemble-criteria step, but the failure is misclassified as an LLM unavailability instead of a config fault
Workflow interpreter records typed exceptions only as undifferentiated strings, causing exception identity loss and source-blind degradation routing that treats all unhandled failures as LLM outages
Plan review verdict must emit fail-closed INDETERMINATE with full deterministic coverage and a distinct config-fault indicator when criteria assembly fails, not llm_unavailable=true
Config-fault verdict diagnostic must name the running installed rebar build as suspect and direct operators to use repository checkout build, not provider credentials
Genuine LLM unavailability errors and healthy plan review paths must remain behaviorally unchanged; deterministic blockers must not be masked by config fault classification
